purpose: After clean committed-tree restore failed, rebuild and flash the main workspace with the D51 three-file patch removed to recover the actual verified runtime state.

source.head: a4da47f60d 记录D48D49 USB实验拒绝并恢复D47基线
source.note: The D51 files have no diff after revert. Other pre-existing dirty worktree changes were left untouched and were part of this recovery build.

gdb.note: CFSR and HFSR were zero; DFSR debug bits are expected after halt. PC halted in normal SPI/IMU thread code, not HardFault_Handler.

decision.reason: Removing D51 and rebuilding the main worktree restores CDC enumeration, MAVLink STANDBY/GREEN, and GDB no-HardFault. D51 remains rejected.
decision.followup: Before the next USB perturbation, consolidate the existing runnable worktree changes into a committed reproducible baseline or create an explicit clean baseline branch. Otherwise clean-worktree experiments will not reproduce the verified runtime.
